description: Return one currency's rate series over a date range, expressed against `base`: `rates` maps each date (or aggregated period) to units of `currency` per 1 `base`. Use for a line chart or raw daily/weekly/monthly/yearly points for one currency. Use `analyze_history` for computed change, trend, and movers; use `convert` or `get_rates` for a single value or snapshot. Defaults: `to` today, `from` 7 days earlier, `base` USD, `interval` daily; coarser intervals average the daily rates per bucket. Returns `{ currency, base, interval, from, to, rates }`. Free plans are limited to the last 30 days; an invalid code or missing history is a 404. Requires a signed-in connection; each successful call bills 1 API request.

base.description: Base currency the rates are expressed against (3-letter ISO 4217). Defaults to USD.

currency.description: The currency whose history to fetch (3-letter ISO 4217), e.g. INR. One currency per call.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to 7 days before `to`.

interval.description: Aggregation: daily (default), weekly, monthly, or yearly. Coarser intervals average the daily rates per bucket (weekly key = the week's Monday, monthly = YYYY-MM, yearly = YYYY).

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today; a future date clamps to today.

name: get_history
title: Currency rate history
